name: github-ticket-read
description: Read a GitHub ticket by ID or link.
script:
set -e
repo="$PECORE_PROJECT_REPO_OWNER/$PECORE_PROJECT_REPO_NAME"
id=${PECORE_PARAMS_TICKET:-$PECORE_TICKET_ID}
case "$id" in "https://$GH_HOST/$repo/issues/"*) id=${id##*/} ;; esac
case "$id" in ""|*[!0-9]*) echo "Enter a ticket ID or link for this repository." >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
gh issue view "$id" --repo "$repo" --json title,body,author | jq -e '{title, body: (.body // ""), author: .author.login}'
